label: theory:tmd-gaussian-lo Gaussian TMD convolutions, Cahn and Sivers terms (SymPy 1.14.0)

status.steps: analytic-derivation within the Gaussian ansatz and O(k/Q) kinematics
status.physics: heuristic-argument (the Gaussian ansatz with constant widths is a model)
status.sivers_sign_change: cited (time reversal, Trento Eq. 14), applied here

order: leading order in alpha_s, leading power in k/Q for F_UU,T and the Sivers term, O(k/Q) for the Cahn cos(phi_h) term; no TMD evolution
assumptions: Gaussian k_perp and p_perp dependence with flavour-independent constant widths (Eqs. 34-35)
p_perp = P_T - z k_perp at O(k/Q) (Eq. 29), x = x_B, z = z_h
Sivers function Delta^N f = 2 N_q(x) h'(k) f(x, k), h' = sqrt(2e) (k/M') exp(-k^2/M'^2) (Eqs. 63, 68)
one-photon exchange; massless partons; target mass and gamma = 2Mx/Q neglected
Drell-Yan q_T shape: convolution of two Gaussian TMD PDFs, no soft factor, no evolution
